drivers.name: Store closure (Monday)
drivers.evidence: Store closed Monday (1/7 of week). No prior closure data, so effect shrunk toward 1.0. 14.3% reduction is direct proportional estimate.

adjustment.analysis: The store closes Monday, reducing the selling period by 1/7 (~14.3%). No other drivers: no promotion, no price change, no holiday. The baseline already reflects seasonal trends and recent sales. The closure is a clear demand reducer. Historical data shows no prior closures, but a 14% reduction is reasonable for a partial-week closure. The classical model suggests no uplift, consistent with no promotion. Noise-adjusted evidence for closures is absent, so shrink toward 1.0. Median multiplier adjusted down by 14.3%. Spreads unchanged: no new uncertainty beyond baseline.
